policy_reference.scope: Existing finite composition-based project classification and hypothetical-model counting convention; historical main counts are not adopted or updated.

project_scope: Source-qualified hypothetical periodic crystal models, not experimental materials or universally distinct chemical substances.
counting_rule: One exact reduced-composition bucket; selected fixed-release model bound by complete file and raw row hashes; no extra polymorph or provider-row credit.

rows.category_basis: All-metal composition; compositional metal-family membership under the existing finite project convention. Metallic electronic behavior unknown.
rows.counting_scope: At most one project identity for this exact reduced composition; other source rows, phases, cells and JIDs receive no additional credit.
rows.overlap_scope: 24 existing formal computed compositions excluded; finite existing source-qualified formula and family guards applied. No universal chemical non-overlap is claimed.
